baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lowered eyes, exit from graves, and spreading-locust comparison span the whole focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sealed population crosses outward from individual enclosures while its gaze contracts and its collective footprint rapidly expands. The locust comparison joins multitude, bodily similarity, and branching motion into one emergence event.

activation_trace.role: Bodily lowering supplies the crowd's surrendered posture at emergence.
Physical sight localizes that lowering in the eyes and marks reduced visual agency.
Passage to an outside turns resurrection into a boundary-crossing motion.
The grave is the literal enclosure from which the boundary crossing begins.
The crop-stripping locust supplies the embodied mass comparison and its consuming mobility.
Unfolding, branching dispersion converts separate exits into a widening collective field.

changed_reading.before: A frightened multitude rises from graves and looks like many scattered locusts.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a coordinated phase change: enclosed individuals become a low-gazed but rapidly widening collective whose very form is boundary crossing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Contracted sight is juxtaposed with outward extraction and maximal public spread.
baseline_models.mechanism: The subjects lose command of looking at the same moment that they are made conspicuous. Lowered eyes contract perception inward, while extraction, uncovering, and spread expose the bodies outward.

activation_trace.role: Lowering and stillness contract the subjects' outward posture.
The eye-sense makes that contraction specifically a loss of surveying sight.
Extraction from concealment makes the formerly hidden occupants publicly manifest.
Removal of a covering intensifies the simile as exposure rather than number alone.
Broad unfolding maximizes the exposed crowd's visibility across the scene.

changed_reading.before: The lowered eyes merely report an emotion such as fear or humility.
changed_reading.after: Visual sovereignty is reversed: the people cannot command the scene by looking, while they themselves are extracted, uncovered, and spread into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns the focus posture into a reversal of visual agency. Earlier, sight of a sign is followed by a chosen turn aside; after the call and the lowered eyes, sight is held forward while bodies hasten toward the caller.

activation_trace.role: The focus lowering supplies the hinge between voluntary aversion and compelled orientation.
Literal eyesight keeps the reversal anchored in the focus body's visual faculty.
Eye-and-insight seeing supplies the earlier moment when the sign is perceptually available.
Turning one's side supplies the earlier voluntary withdrawal from what was seen.
A vocal summons supplies the external attractor immediately before the focus posture.
Sustained forward gaze supplies the post-focus orientation that replaces turning aside.
Rapid approach converts fixed gaze into compelled bodily follow-through.
The repeated caller closes the sequence by naming the destination of gaze and motion.

structural_cues: 54:2 couples seeing a sign with turning aside.
54:6 places the caller immediately before 54:7, and 54:8 resumes with gaze and haste toward that caller.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing, aversion, summons, lowered sight, and forward haste; I infer a reversal from chosen visual evasion to compelled orientation. A live alternative is that these are adjacent fear gestures without retributive symmetry.

changed_reading.before: Downcast eyes are a static sign of fear during resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The eyes enact a reversal: those who once saw and turned aside now lose freedom over gaze and direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verses flanking the focus give the apparently dispersed swarm a common vector. A summons precedes the emergence, and rapid approach toward the same caller follows it, so branching distribution and directed motion coexist.

activation_trace.role: The locust body supplies dense collective movement rather than isolated walkers.
Branching spread supplies distributed positions across the moving collective.
The spoken summons supplies a shared attractor before the crowd appears.
Rapid forward approach supplies velocity toward that attractor.
Submissive compliance makes the shared direction imposed rather than negotiated.
The caller named after the focus confirms the endpoint of the collective motion.

structural_cues: The same caller brackets the focus through 54:6 and 54:8.
The focus says spread, while 54:8 specifies motion toward one destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a call, a spreading swarm, and haste toward the caller; I assign the call as the vectoring cause. A live alternative is simple sequence: the crowd first disperses and only afterward reorients.

changed_reading.before: The locust simile suggests random or radial scattering from the graves.
changed_reading.after: The swarm is distributed but not directionless: one summons organizes many exits into a common trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Apparent swarm disorder is nested inside a sequence of settling affairs, summons, and measured determination. Spread becomes the visible geometry of execution rather than a lapse of control.

activation_trace.role: Locust multitude supplies the surface impression of turbulent, hard-to-count motion.
Branching dispersion supplies the apparent spatial disorder to be re-read.
The affair as a determinate state supplies the unit that will come to settlement.
Fixity and settlement place each affair against the swarm's apparent instability.
The summons supplies an operative command that can organize the emergence.
The returning affair language links the later measured event back to the earlier settling pattern.
Deliberate apportioning supplies governance by prior measure beneath visible motion.

structural_cues: 54:3 states that every affair reaches settlement before the resurrection scene.
54:12 describes the meeting waters as occurring upon an affair already measured.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies settlement, summons, dispersal, and prior measure; I infer that measured command governs the crowd's distributed motion. A live alternative is that determination applies only to the flood episode, leaving the locust image purely chaotic.

changed_reading.before: The spread crowd is an image of overwhelming chaos.
changed_reading.after: Its turbulence is surface-level: the many-bodied distribution executes a settled and measured event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeats an architecture of closed domains opening and releasing contents: an initial split, gates opened above, outpouring, eruption from below, and eventual meeting. Exit from graves can therefore be heard as the human instance of a wider release system.

activation_trace.role: Outward passage supplies the focus event's release across an enclosure boundary.
The grave supplies the closed terrestrial chamber whose contents emerge.
Widening dispersion supplies the released contents' expansion after crossing the boundary.
Rupture and opening establish the surah's first breached-boundary image.
Opening a closure supplies the later release mechanism from above.
The entryway image materializes the boundary through which the upper contents pass.
Pouring discharge supplies the forceful outward flow after opening.
Wide splitting and emission mirror release from below the ground.
Two opposed flows meeting shows that released multiplicity can still converge.

structural_cues: 54:11-12 stage release from above and below, followed by convergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated openings, emissions, and a meeting; I generalize their spatial grammar to the grave exit in 54:7. A live alternative is that the flood mechanics remain a separate exemplum and do not color the resurrection scene.

changed_reading.before: The dead simply move from graves to the surface.
changed_reading.after: Their emergence is a dry human outflow within a repeated system of breached enclosures: release spreads many contents, then subjects them to convergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers terrain and revival branch images from roots grammatically attached to eyes, locusts, and spreading into an ecological scene. It remains anchored in the focus ayah's low posture, graves, locust body, and spread, with nearby water-and-earth cues reinforcing it. Render it only as a branch-level material analogy, not as a claim that the syntax identifies the eyes with soil.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The low posture, grave substrate, locust comparison, and spreading predicate permit an ecological reanimation analogy.

activation_trace.role: Low dormant terrain lends the lowered posture a latent ground-state image.
The grave fixes that latency inside the earth rather than in an abstract state.
The vegetation-stripping insect supplies the biological eruption and its relation to land cover.
Dry growth revived by rain supplies an ecological analogue for renewed life and spread.
Heavy pouring supplies the rain-like input that activates the dormant-ground analogy.
Soft productive earth supplies the substrate from which renewed life can issue.
Flowing springs supply internal watering from below as a second activation route.

changed_reading.before: The scene is juridical resurrection illustrated by the number and scatter of locusts.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also resembles a post-rain biological eruption: dormant ground releases a sudden, spreading life-form from beneath its cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant mapped push branch of the call root and a military branch of the locust root. Both remain packet-resolvable and attach to the focus exit and spread, while the caller and haste flank the ayah. Downstream prose must mark this as a form-distant kinetic analogy, not replace the ordinary senses of call or locust.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Exit, the locust-root comparison, and spread can be recast as a forced mustering of detached bodies.

activation_trace.role: Outward passage supplies the bodies' forced release from their prior stations.
A detached troop supplies the muster-like collective image latent beside the literal locust.
Deployment by branching spread supplies the formation's distributed shape.
The split root's severe-pushing image recasts the preceding call as kinetic pressure.
The same push image at the destination brackets the focus with coercive momentum.
Rapid approach supplies the mustered formation's forward execution.

changed_reading.before: A caller summons a crowd that resembles dispersed insects.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the call behaves like pressure ejecting and mustering a detached formation from the graves.

strongest_changes: The locust field is distributed yet vectorized by a repeated caller.
Sight changes from chosen turning-away to lowered, compelled orientation.
Grave emergence joins a repeated architecture of opening, discharge, and convergence.
Apparent swarm disorder can execute a settled and measured event.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah contracts gaze while expanding bodies across space, allowing the same image to carry surrender, exposure, collective dynamics, and material release without collapsing them into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the stripping and dormant-ground branches are active resonances or only distant lexical echoes.
Whether the flood's opening-and-flow sequence intentionally colors grave emergence or merely supplies an adjacent analogy.
Whether lowered sight and sustained forward gaze are simultaneous facets of one posture or successive phases.
